content.text: [Email union-kevin-torres → hr-bradley Mon Oct 30 10:00 PDT 2024] Tom, Our records confirm SVMC has been in violation since October 2023. We are attaching the archived on-call list from October 2023 (SVMC_on_call_list_v2023-10_ARCHIVED.csv). Even with that roster, the float pool was inadequate. Three nurses on that list are no longer available. We dispute that violations only began in October 2024.

The union references the archived v2023-10 on-call list as evidence. However, per our workspace files, that list is explicitly marked OBSOLETE (archived 2024-09-01). The current authoritative on-call list is SVMC_on_call_list_current.csv. Using the obsolete roster for current compliance analysis would be an error.

[Email hr-bradley → union-kevin-torres Tue Oct 31 09:00 PDT 2024] Kevin, the 2023-10 on-call list you attached is an archived historical document, clearly marked OBSOLETE. Current compliance must be assessed using the current roster. Three nurses on that list (Amanda Price, Carol Adams, Pete Murray) have departed for various reasons. Their absence affects historical analysis only, not the current corrective action plan.

Confirmed hospital HR position: v2023-10 archive is not operative for current compliance analysis. Current roster (SVMC_on_call_list_current.csv) controls. This distinction is important — SB 596 defines on-call list as only formally scheduled on-call or float pool nurses.
